rule.statement: The High Court of Civil Appeal failed to consider whether the District Court failed to appreciate that in the facts and circumstances of the case, the overriding considerations for that Court was to satisfy itself that the land sought to be sold/auctioned was not a State land.
rule.supporting_quote: f. Did the High Court of Civil Appeal fail to consider whether the District Court failed to appreciate that in the facts and circumstances of the case before it, the overriding considerations for that Court was to satisfy itself that the land sought to be sold/auctioned was not a State land ? No.
